title: TERRA IN THE PLAZA
logline: On a market afternoon, a young woman stops by a fountain and looks at a cafe.
grade: 2D anime film, hand-drawn cel animation, painted backgrounds, soft afternoon sunlight, gentle colours.
avoid: lowres, blurry, morphing, warping, melting buildings, bending walls, flicker, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, two of the same person, subtitles, captions, watermark, nsfw
score_tags: gentle anime slice-of-life score, acoustic guitar, soft strings, instrumental, no vocals

place.prompt: A small Italian hill-town square on a market afternoon, painted as an anime background.

terra.prompt: Terra from the front: her character sheet's front view.

shots.name: the square, and her
shots.title: the square, and her
shots.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation. A high wide view of a sunlit Italian hill-town square in the afternoon: the stone clock tower, the ochre cafe with its red-and-white striped awning, a fruit stall under a yellow striped canopy, strings of lights across the square, the round stone fountain with a red bicycle leaning on it. A young woman with long wavy sea-green hair tied with a red ribbon, a sleeveless red dress, a lilac sash and red boots stands alone near the fountain, looking toward the cafe. The camera glides slowly forward and down. Water splashes in the fountain; her hair and sash stir in the breeze. Sound: the fountain splashing, a light breeze, distant swallows, the murmur of a market. No music.
shots.avoid_extra: other people, a crowd, a second woman, a man, 3d render, cgi, photorealistic, live action

shots.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation. A medium shot: a young woman with long wavy sea-green hair tied with a red ribbon, a sleeveless red dress, a lilac sash and red boots stands facing the camera in a sunlit Italian square, the round stone fountain and the white house with blue shutters behind her. She looks toward the cafe, then smiles softly; her hair and her lilac sash move in the breeze. The camera moves slowly closer. Sound: the fountain splashing, a light breeze, distant swallows, the murmur of a market. No music.
